sources.title: Katapull launch: Logic4, DeliveryMatch, EffectConnect, Highbiza and Vendit join forces
Katapull breidt Commerce Hub uit met overname van Picqer
Vendit partners: EffectConnect, DeliveryMatch, Transus, Highbiza, Returnista, Logic4
Transus meets Hornbach requirement with EDI and SSCC label service
DeliveryMatch on the Shopify App Store
Returnista - Return & Exchange on the Shopify App Store

items.title: Katapull serves 4,500+ customers with 27,500+ users across eight platforms
items.summary: Katapull reports 175+ specialists, 4,500+ customers in 40+ countries, 27,500+ users and 140+ marketplaces across Highbiza, Vendit, DeliveryMatch, EffectConnect, Logic4, Transus, Returnista and Picqer.
items.implication: The share of these customers that use more than one platform is not published; it is the key number for hub strategy.

items.title: The hub was assembled by acquisition in under two years
items.summary: Five brands formed Katapull in March 2025 (Logic4, DeliveryMatch, EffectConnect, Highbiza, Vendit); Returnista joined in February 2026 and Picqer in October 2026. Transus is listed in the Commerce Hub.
items.implication: Integrations are uneven: older pairs are documented, newer ones are partner listings or inferences. Shared customers feel the gaps first.

items.title: DeliveryMatch is the most connected platform in the hub
items.summary: DeliveryMatch publishes integration pages for Logic4, Vendit, EffectConnect, Highbiza, Transus, Returnista and Picqer, each stating the product is coupled with DeliveryMatch.
items.implication: Shipping is the natural entry point for cross-selling: almost every shared customer persona uses DeliveryMatch in at least one job.

items.title: Vendit is the hub of the retail stack
items.summary: Vendit documents connections to EffectConnect (marketplace module), DeliveryMatch (labels), Transus (EDI) and Highbiza (webshop); Returnista and Logic4 are partner listings only.
items.implication: Retailers can already run store, online, marketplace, shipping and supplier EDI on one Vendit-centred stack; returns are the gap.

items.title: Picqer, DeliveryMatch and Returnista form a ready 3PL chain
items.summary: Picqer integrates DeliveryMatch for carriers and has a native two-way Returnista integration; Picqer's co-founder announced even better integration with both at the acquisition.
items.implication: Fulfilment companies and their clients are the shared customers where three platforms already work as one flow.

items.title: Logic4 and EffectConnect are the oldest sibling pair
items.summary: EffectConnect has been a Logic4 sister company since 2021 and documents a Logic4 integration; in the Fitwinkel case Logic4 phased out its own bol.com link for EffectConnect.
items.implication: Proves the pattern of retiring overlapping functions in favour of a sibling platform; candidates are Logic4 POS vs Vendit and Logic4 webshop vs Highbiza.

items.title: Picqer is positioned as the WMS step-up for Logic4 customers
items.summary: Katapull's acquisition release positions Picqer for Logic4 customers whose warehouse needs go beyond Logic4; no connector is published yet.
items.implication: A Logic4-Picqer bridge is the most valuable missing link for trading companies and their operations leads.

items.title: E-invoicing mandates pull Transus into every trading company
items.summary: Germany requires e-invoices from 2027 (turnover above EUR 800,000) and 2028 (all); Transus supports Peppol, XRechnung and ZUGFeRD and is a listed partner of every sibling.
items.implication: Finance and IT leads of Logic4 and Vendit customers are natural Transus customers; the Logic4-Transus bridge is inferred, not documented.

items.title: EffectConnect embedded integrations are the partner model of the hub
items.summary: DeliveryMatch is the reference partner for EffectConnect Embedded Integrations, offering marketplace connectivity inside its own product.
items.implication: The same embedding pattern can let partners and siblings expose any Katapull capability under their own brand.

items.title: Four Katapull platforms sell into Shopify stores
items.summary: DeliveryMatch has had a free Shopify app since August 2019 and Returnista since July 2023. Picqer builds its own Shopify connector, and EffectConnect offers a Shopify plugin that syncs products, stock and orders.
items.implication: Shopify competes with Highbiza, Vendit and Logic4 for the store and the system of record, but it is a host platform for the fulfilment side of the hub. Shopify merchants are a shared-customer segment that can use four Katapull platforms without any Katapull core system.
